name: Masala Oats with Soy Chunks
steps: Soak soy chunks in boiling water for 10 minutes. Drain, rinse and squeeze firmly; chop into bite-size pieces.
Heat oil in a saucepan. Add cumin and onion; cook 2 minutes.
Add vegetables, soy chunks and spices; stir for 2 minutes.
Add water and bring to a simmer. Stir in oats and cook 5–7 minutes until creamy.
Finish with lemon and coriander. Adjust consistency with hot water and serve.
note: Soy chunks vary by brand; nutrition estimate assumes plain defatted soy chunks.

inspirationReferences.title: Oats Upma Recipe
inspirationReferences.note: Savory oats tempering and vegetable-upma technique; soy chunks and spice balance are original.
